sermon.title: A Fruitful Christian - October 13, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: New creatures bear fruit. Many believe but few attend; yet those with us are more than the enemy. Laws can’t overwrite God’s law on theft or life; provoke one another to love; the remnant, like the abolitionists, sticks with truth and bears the fruit of the Spirit.
